static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Mother拥有一家时尚品牌，与Mother关系亲密
static_traits.social_status: 有一群支持性的朋友，但尚not yet与他们分享自卑与Self-doubt；与同事关系因Self-doubt而显得疏离
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题史；without心理治疗或咨询史；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能够自我Reflection，配合度较高；主观感受为“Anxiety”“尴尬”；愿意尝试行为实验并记录观察

basic_info.main_problem: “我因为have not自己的时尚品牌而觉得自己not够好、很愚蠢，这种not足感和Self-doubt正在影响我的自尊心。”问题在3个月前开始（入职Accountant工作时），工作压力增高，与Mother成就的比较加剧了not足感，只要看到Mother的事业成功就会trigger。
basic_info.core_demands: “持续的not足感和Self-doubt已经开始影响我的工作表现和整体幸福感，因此我寻求咨询以获得支持和指导。”
growth_experiences: In the family of origin, the mother owns a successful fashion brand and the client is close to the mother; long being in a family atmosphere that takes the mother's career success as a reference formed a comparison framework measuring self-worth by external achievement.

special_situations.event: 看到Mother在事业上的成功或被公众认可
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not像Mother那样拥有自己的时尚品牌，就说明我失败、很愚蠢
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 与同事保持距离、Reduced socializing；not向朋友表达感受以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not可能像她一样成功；我很愚蠢

special_situations.event: Feeling high pressure at work or when mistakes occur
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake at work, it proves I am just stupid and my career choice has failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-doubt并减少与同事交流以避免暴露not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited for this job；我就是很笨

special_situations.event: 考虑向朋友分享not足感与Self-doubt
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果表达脆弱与困扰，do not人会认为我在抱怨或很荒唐
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am complaining and laughable

special_situations.event: 想到自己have not自己的品牌并与Mother进行比较
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有拥有像Mother一样的成功事业才算有价值，否则I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate自身已有的成就与优点；not去尝试新的兴趣以避免失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我现在的成就not算数；I am worthless

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可和被看见，拥有与Mother相当的成就以证明自我价值
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较后显得not够好，被评价为愚蠢与失败
defense_goal: Avoids others' evaluations through self-deprecation and keeping distance
避免表达脆弱以减少羞耻与被negate的风险

object_relations.object_representation: 成功、受赞赏的榜样与潜在评判者（Mother/他人）
会评价我、可能看not起我的同事

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当Mother的成功被谈论或被公众认可时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为自己被比较与negate，他人会以外在成就衡量我的价值
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopts a self-critical and self-deprecating tone, reduces proactively expressing needs, responds briefly and avoids eye contact.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当考虑向朋友倾诉not足感与Self-doubt时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Speculates that friends will think I am complaining or being absurd (projecting my own sense of shame onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use推测他人想法的表述（如“他们会觉得…”），语气犹疑，用回避性句式结束话题。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When questioned at work or making mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Defines oneself entirely by one mistake (sees oneself as 'all bad')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化词语（如“总是/从not”）描述自己，语气低落并拒绝讨论细节或灰度。

manifestations: 以Mother的外在成就作为自我价值的唯一参照
Ignores her existing achievements (job and degree); questions 'whether I am worthy'
与同事保持距离、显得not友好
面对支持性朋友却not表达真实感受

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Speculates friends will think oneself is complaining or ridiculous
假设他人会以Mother的成就来评价自己

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequent self-blame and labeling oneself as 'stupid'
Keeping distance in front of colleagues, interacting cautiously

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 有支持性的朋友却选择not表达真实感受
Suppresses the outward urge to seek help back into oneself and stays silent

positive_force: 具备Bachelor's degree学历与稳定职业，说明一定的能力与坚持
与Mother关系亲密，潜在获得情感支持的资源
有支持性的朋友圈（虽暂not yetuse）
Willing to try behavioral experiments and keep records, has motivation to change
negative_force: 强烈的比较与外部验证倾向
Cognitive pattern of labeling and overgeneralization ('I am stupid')
非黑即白思维导致自我价值全盘negate
Social avoidance与not表达脆弱，致使支持系统not yet被利用
Increased work stress and impaired attention form a negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: 自我贬低与标签化（频繁以“我很愚蠢”“I am not good enough”定义自己）
antecedent: 看到Mother的事业成功或被认可
想到自己have not自己的品牌
工作中出现错误或高压力
target_behavior.core_reason: 以外在成就（与Mother相比较）作为价值标准，形成灾难化与过度概括的认知
target_behavior.function: 通过Self-denial与Withdrawal来暂时缓解被评判与失败的Anxiety（回避性功能）
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、Decline in work performance、Interpersonal relationships疏离、兴趣活动减少

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance（与同事保持距离、not向朋友表达真实感受）
antecedent: 担心被认为在抱怨或荒唐
target_behavior.core_reason: Prediction and mind reading of others' negative evaluations, shame-driven defense
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluations and shame, maintaining short-term psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: 社会支持not yet被利用，Interpersonal tension与Loneliness感增加

target_behavior.behavior: Reduced interest activities (hiking activities markedly reduced)
target_behavior.core_reason: 情绪化推理与“非黑即白”式自我评价导致Decreased motivation
target_behavior.function: 避免在活动中再次体验失败或Meaninglessness感
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased quality of life、恢复力降低、负性情绪维持或加重
